title: Daidzin improves the cisplatin chemosensitivity for osteosarcoma via binding to beta-catenin protein and suppressing the wnt pathway.
authors: Wang, Peng; Lu, Hao; Zhang, Chi; Wang, Renwei; Chen, Xiaobo; Qiao, Lixin; Wang, Zhiyong; Wang, Wenge
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物daidzin与beta-catenin蛋白结合并抑制Wnt通路以增敏骨肉瘤化疗，虽含分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模无关。
abstract: Osteosarcoma (OS) mainly occurs in adolescents and children, accompanied with chemotherapy resistance as well as unsatisfactory treatment outcome. Recent studies have discovered a series of natural products with anticancer activity, which have important translational value. Daidzin has been reported with a variety of biological activities. We aim to explore whether daidzin has therapeutic potential for OS. In this study, cell based and in vivo studies showed that daidzin can inhibit the ability of OS cells to proliferate and metastasize. Compared to single treatment arms, combined treatment of daidzin and cisplatin, a classic recommendation for OS treatment, showed a further suppression in OS cell viability, migration and invasion ability, and led to further apoptosis. Mechanistically, daidzin was found to downregulate the beta-catenin expression and further inhibited the Wnt pathway. However, daidzin did not alter the transcriptional level of beta-catenin. Molecular docking showed a potential interaction between daidzin and beta-catenin protein, and their combination was further confirmed by thermal shift assay and MST assay. Daidzin was found to reduced protein stability of beta-catenin, and only transfection of beta-catenin mutant (a mutant that targets the binding sites to daidzin) at the same time as daidzin treatment could effectively attenuate the antitumor effect of daidzin. Our study suggests that daidzin has translational value as a potential adjuvant to improve treatment outcomes for OS.
abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤（osteosarcoma, OS）主要发生于青少年和儿童，常伴随化疗耐药及不理想的治疗结果。近期研究发现了多种具有抗癌活性的天然产物，这些产物具有重要的转化价值。大豆苷元（daidzin）已被报道具有多种生物活性。我们旨在探讨大豆苷元是否对OS具有治疗潜力。在本研究中，基于细胞和体内研究表明，大豆苷元能抑制OS细胞的增殖和转移能力。与单一治疗组相比，大豆苷元与顺铂（OS治疗的经典推荐药物）联合治疗进一步抑制了OS细胞的活力、迁移和侵袭能力，并导致进一步的凋亡。机制上，发现大豆苷元下调β-连环蛋白（beta-catenin）表达，并进一步抑制Wnt通路。然而，大豆苷元并未改变β-连环蛋白的转录水平。分子对接显示大豆苷元与β-连环蛋白之间存在潜在相互作用，其结合进一步通过热位移实验和微量热泳动（MST）实验得到确认。发现大豆苷元降低了β-连环蛋白的蛋白稳定性，且仅在大豆苷元处理同时转染β-连环蛋白突变体（一种靶向大豆苷元结合位点的突变体）能有效减弱大豆苷元的抗肿瘤效果。我们的研究表明，大豆苷元作为潜在辅助药物具有转化价值，可改善OS的治疗结果。
